source_text: Proponents counter that UNCRC Article 3 (best interests of the child) incorporates evidence-based health benefits, such as a 50-60% reduction in heterosexual HIV acquisition per randomized trials in Africa, and that parental proxy consent aligns with cultural rights under Article 30, rejecting absolutist interpretations that ignore net welfare gains.
